title: There Is A Habitation
firstLine: There is a habitation, built by the living God,

lines: There is a habitation, built by the living God,
For all, of ev'ry nation, who seek the grand abode.
A city with foundations Firm as the eternal throne,
No wars, nor desolations Shall ever move a stone.
No night is there, no sorrow, No death and no decay;
No yesterday, no morrow, but one eternal day.
With in its pearly portals, Angelic armies sing,
With glorified immortals, The praises of its King.
I long thy gates to see;
When shall I dwell in Thee?
